integrity: Complete standalone standard-library exhaustive verifier included; first-public-source evidence from the arXiv initial version. No claim of external certification or broader general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite census only through six vertices; all-graphs comparator is essential. The general C2 identification characterizations of 2015 subsume individual membership questions. Separate prior restricted-class threshold statements have different comparator domains. Inaccessible or unindexed historical tabulations remain a priority risk. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: First global counting-logic ambiguity among connected block graphs occurs at six vertices
